description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID列表。使用`["<实例ID 1>","<实例ID 2>",……]`格式表示。
description.en: The number of the page to return.

description.zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护套餐类型。取值：

- **0**：表示专业版。
- **1**：表示企业版。
description.en:
The field that is used to sort the Anti-DDoS Origin instances. Set the value to **expireTime**, which indicates that the instances are sorted based on the expiration time.

You can set the **Orderdire** parameter to specify the sorting method.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护套餐类型。
description.en: The total number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护对象IP。
description.en:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- **desc**: the descending order. This is the default value.

- **asc**: the ascending order.

description.zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例防护的IP资产的协议类型。取值：

- **IPv4**：表示IPv4协议。
- **IPv6**：表示IPv6协议。
description.en: The IP address of the object that is protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

description.zh:
设置DDoS原生防护实例列表的排序字段。取值固定为**expireTime**，表示按照实例的到期时间排序。

您可以通过**Orderdire**参数设置排序方式。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
设置排序方式。取值：

- **desc**（默认）：表示按照到期时间降序排序。
- **asc**：表示按照到期时间升序排序。
description.en: The tags that are added to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
description.en:
The protocol type of the IP address asset that is protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

- **Ipv4**: IPv4

- **Ipv6**: IPv6

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量。
description.en:
The mitigation plan of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

- **0**: the Professional mitigation plan

- **1**: the Enterprise mitigation plan

description.zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
description.en: The tag that is added to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的备注。支持模糊查询。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en: The remarks of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签列表。
description.en: The key of the tag that is added to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签键。
description.en: The mitigation plan of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签值。
description.en:
The mitigation plan of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Valid values:

- 0: the Professional mitigation plan.

- 1: the Enterprise mitigation plan.

title.zh: 查询防护包实例的详细信息

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于分页查询当前阿里云账号拥有的所有DDoS原生防护实例的详情，例如，实例的ID、有效期、状态等。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: Retrieves the details of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp describe-instance-list --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --instance-id-list ddosbgp-cn-oew1pjrk0000 --remark test --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --ip-version IPv4 --instance-type 0 --ip 47.89.XX.XX --orderby expireTime --orderdire desc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --instance-type-list 0 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddosbgp DescribeInstanceList --region cn-hangzhou --Orderby expireTime --Tag.1.Key 'test-key' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --PageSize 10 --Orderdire desc --IpVersion IPv4 --Ip '47.89.XX.XX' --Remark test --InstanceTypeList.1 0 --Tag.1.Value 'test-value' --PageNo 1 --InstanceIdList 'ddosbgp-cn-oew1pjrk0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType 0 --method POST --force
